name: Akshan - Mischievous
texts: [Weaponmaster] You may pay :rb_rune_body::rb_rune_body: as an additional cost to play me. When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move an enemy gear to your base. You control it until I leave the board. If it's an Equipment, attach it to me.
manual: You may pay :rb_rune_body::rb_rune_body: as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move an enemy gear to your base.
You control it until I leave the board.
If it's an Equipment, attach it to me.
